diseases.cause: Caused by fungal spores that thrive in high humidity and poor air circulation.
diseases.recommendation: Monitor drainage and reduce watering. Apply appropriate fungicides.

organicSolutions.name: Neem Oil Spray
organicSolutions.note: Eco-friendly. Apply in early morning or evening to avoid leaf burn.

organicSolutions.name: Garlic-Based Organic Fungicide
organicSolutions.note: Natural antifungal properties. Strain before spraying.

organicSolutions.name: Copper Soap Fungicide (Organic)
organicSolutions.note: OMRI certified. Safe for organic farming.

chemicalSolutions.name: Mancozeb 75% WP
chemicalSolutions.note: Wear protective gloves and mask. Do not spray during flowering.

chemicalSolutions.name: Propiconazole 25% EC
chemicalSolutions.note: Systemic fungicide. Follow PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) of 7 days.

chemicalSolutions.name: Bordeaux Mixture
chemicalSolutions.note: Traditional copper-based fungicide. Avoid during hot weather.

preventionTips: Plant resistant varieties suitable for your climate
Ensure proper spacing (30-45cm) between plants for air circulation
Avoid overhead watering; use drip irrigation instead
Water early in the day to allow foliage to dry
Remove plant debris regularly and compost away from crops
Practice 2-3 year crop rotation
Apply balanced fertilization to strengthen plant immunity

diseases.cause: Result of excess moisture on leaves combined with warm, stagnant air.
diseases.recommendation: Prune infected leaves immediately. Increase air circulation.

organicSolutions.name: Baking Soda Solution
organicSolutions.dosage: 1 tablespoon per gallon (4 liters) of water + few drops dish soap
organicSolutions.note: Safe and effective. Soap helps solution stick to leaves.

organicSolutions.name: Milk Spray
organicSolutions.note: Natural antifungal. Use fresh milk for best results.

organicSolutions.name: Sulfur-Based Organic Fungicide
organicSolutions.note: Do not apply when temperature exceeds 32°C (90°F).

chemicalSolutions.name: Myclobutanil 10% WP
chemicalSolutions.note: Systemic action. Wear protective equipment during application.

chemicalSolutions.name: Potassium Bicarbonate
chemicalSolutions.note: Less toxic alternative. Can be used close to harvest.

preventionTips: Choose resistant varieties for your region
Provide adequate spacing (40-50cm) for air flow
Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which promotes soft growth
Water at soil level, never on leaves
Prune to improve light penetration and air movement
Remove infected leaves immediately and destroy
Maintain soil pH between 6.0-7.0 for optimal plant health

diseases.cause: Bacterial or fungal infection often spread by wind and rain in early spring.
diseases.recommendation: Remove affected plants immediately. Rotate crops next season.

organicSolutions.name: Copper-Based Organic Bactericide
organicSolutions.note: OMRI listed. Apply preventively before disease appears.

organicSolutions.name: Bacillus subtilis Biofungicide
organicSolutions.note: Beneficial bacteria. Safe for beneficial insects.

organicSolutions.name: Compost Tea
organicSolutions.note: Boosts plant immunity. Use well-aerated compost tea only.

chemicalSolutions.name: Copper Hydroxide 77% WP
chemicalSolutions.note: Protective fungicide. Wear mask and gloves during application.

chemicalSolutions.name: Streptomycin Sulfate (for bacterial blight)
chemicalSolutions.note: Antibiotic. Use only when necessary. PHI: 14 days.

chemicalSolutions.name: Chlorothalonil 75% WP
chemicalSolutions.note: Broad-spectrum. Do not mix with other pesticides.

chemicalSolutions.name: Mancozeb 75% WP (Preventive)
chemicalSolutions.note: Start before disease appears. PHI: 7 days.

preventionTips: Use only certified disease-free seeds and transplants
Practice 3-4 year crop rotation with non-host crops
Avoid working with plants when foliage is wet
Sanitize all tools with 10% bleach solution between plants
Remove and destroy volunteer plants immediately
Apply organic mulch to prevent soil splash onto leaves
Maintain proper plant nutrition with balanced fertilizers
Install drip irrigation to keep foliage dry
Remove crop residues immediately after harvest

diseases.cause: Optimal soil nutrients and climate conditions maintained.
diseases.recommendation: No action needed. Keep maintaining current care practices.

organicSolutions.name: Compost Application
organicSolutions.note: Maintains soil health and beneficial microbes.

organicSolutions.name: Organic Mulch
organicSolutions.note: Conserves moisture and suppresses weeds naturally.

organicSolutions.name: Seaweed Extract
organicSolutions.note: Boosts plant immunity and stress tolerance.

chemicalSolutions.name: Balanced NPK Fertilizer (19:19:19)
chemicalSolutions.note: Adjust based on soil test results.

chemicalSolutions.name: Micronutrient Mix (Zn, Fe, Mn, B)
chemicalSolutions.note: Apply only if deficiency is confirmed through testing.

preventionTips: Continue regular monitoring for early disease detection
Maintain proper watering schedule based on crop needs
Keep balanced nutrition through soil testing every 6 months
Practice integrated pest management (IPM)
Maintain soil pH between 6.0-7.0 for most crops
Ensure good drainage to prevent waterlogging
Rotate crops annually to prevent soil depletion
Keep farm records for better decision making
